final: SELECT status, avg_modelconf, avg_modelconf - overall_avg_modelconf AS above_average, avg_modelconf / (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS group_avg FROM compliancecase GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, '(no status)') HAVING AVG(modelconf) > (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase)) AS qualifying_statuses) AS relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM (SELECT COALESCE(brokrepstat, '(no status)') AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf, (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) AS overall_avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, '(no status)')) AS status_averages WHERE avg_modelconf > overall_avg_modelconf AND overall_avg_modelconf IS NOT NULL AND avg_modelconf IS NOT NULL
